body:
Added real per-bone mass (proportional to parent-bone length) and a real bend constraint (one-sided min-distance to grandparent) to the S484 spike. Live-verified: bend constraint works exactly as designed (0/63 violated at final state), but the whole body still collapses flat -- a conclusive finding, not a tuning problem, since distance constraints have no concept of orientation relative to gravity. Phase 2 is now sharply defined: real per-bone orientation + angular joint limits (true rigid-body dynamics), not an extension of point-mass PBD. SHANKPIT 2d11d67.

⚓ ☃
title: Ragdoll spike iteration 2: mass + bend constraints, Phase 2 sharply defined (S494)
